name: open-claude-in-fayarkitsune
description: Browser automation in Firefox through the Claude MCP in Fayar kitsune extension.
long_description: MCP server for the Claude MCP in Fayar kitsune Firefox extension. Install the extension in Firefox; it connects to this server over a WebSocket on 127.0.0.1:18765. Nothing else to set up: no native messaging host, no Node.js install, no registry keys.

tools.name: tabs_context_mcp
tools.description: List tabs in the MCP tab group

tools.name: tabs_create_mcp
tools.description: Open a new tab in the MCP tab group

tools.name: tabs_close_mcp
tools.description: Close tabs in the MCP tab group, or tabs the user shared

tools.name: tabs_request_access
tools.description: Ask the user to share some of their own tabs

tools.name: tabs_request_handover
tools.description: Move shared tabs into Claude's window, once the user agrees

tools.name: tabs_release
tools.description: Stop using a tab the user shared

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Go to a URL, or back/forward

tools.name: handle_dialog
tools.description: Choose the answer to the next confirm or prompt

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Note a plan (there is no approval step)

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload a screenshot to a file input or drop target

tools.name: file_upload
tools.description: Upload files from this computer to a file input, once the user agrees

tools.name: debug
tools.description: What the extension actually did, step by step
